ns2:section.sectionText: Note: This section open only to graduate students in Advertising and College of Communications PhD students. Meets with ADV 400-K (CRN 49679) Topic: Fit, Fat and Fashion: Body Image in Advertising and Consumer Culture. This course examines body images in advertising and consumer culture. Students will learn about cultural, political and economic factors shaping representations of human bodies in the media. This course will increase students' sophistication in understanding the issues of representing race, gender, age, health and social status. This course will also cover public health effects of poor body image and its role in contemporary nutrition marketing.
